title: Can Brands Circumvent Marketing Regulations? Exploiting Umbrella Branding in Financial Markets
authors: Yan Lu; Debanjan Mitra; David K. Musto; Sugata Ray
eligible_reason: Single common event (JOBS Act lifting of the hedge-fund advertising ban, pre_dummy) for all funds; no unit FE. Table 4 is pooled OLS of hedge-fund flows on a mutual-fund advertising dummy with many time-varying controls; Table 5 is logit/Poisson of mutual-fund advertising with pre-period interactions; Table 6 is model-free means by pre/post and performance tercile; Table 7 compares actual vs placebo umbrella pairs with logit.
design_notes: codes/marketing_4MS.do: reg lead12oflow1 ad_spend_dummy lag12oflow1 ... yeardummy*, robust (Table 4); logit ad_spend pre_dummy ... cluster(fund_id) (Table 5); poisson ad_clock/ad_ratio (Table 5); sum ... if pre_dummy==1/0 & lag12onefactor_group (Table 6).
data_files_note: readme.txt: data from Lipper TASS, CRSP and Adspender cannot be distributed; shipped files contain 70-80% of the full data with identifiers removed.
data_provenance_note: 70-80% subsample of licensed data; sampling rule not stated; identifiers removed. Moot (design ineligible).
